_source: Stuart Hames's 'Media Spend Tracker 2026.xlsx', received 2026-09-01. Original in data/veltuff/uploads/Media-Spend-Tracker-2026.xlsx. Sheets: Media Budget Tracker (UK, GBP), Media Budget Tracker EU (currency reads as DKK/Kr — CONFIRM with Stuart), Total Spend (daily; UK Meta billed in DKK, converted to GBP at ~0.1147), UK/INT Orders, Budget Allocation.
_notes: Media split UK: Google non-brand 63%, Google brand 7%, Meta 30% of media budget.
'Actual Meta Spend VENDO' row = the Meta budget agreed with Vendo (April cut 8000->5600, May-Jun 3600, back to 7500 from July).
Stuart's '5x' = the Meta Planned ROAS row: 5.0 every month Aug-Dec (UK). Blended MER target is separate: Sep 4.5 rising to ~5.4 by Dec.
His tracker converts UK Meta DKK->GBP at ~0.1147 (from Total Spend sheet). Our reports have used 0.11 - switch to ~0.115 or state basis, else spend reads ~4% low vs his numbers.
He reconciles Meta spend via PayPal withdrawals (GBP 500 threshold) and Google via bank charges (GBP 1000 threshold).

EU._note: Vendo does NOT manage the EU side (Toby, 2026-09-01). Retained for context only - Stuart's tracker covers both markets. Never report on or make recommendations for EU spend.

actuals_2026_stuart_mtd.note: EU Meta ran 138% of its Aug budget on Stuart's tracker; May hit 328%. Context only - EU is not Vendo-managed.
